answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop fakes. Each epoch a beacon samples agents; sampled agents must answer a heartbeat promptly, proving one machine per identity. A miss drops that identity to its nadir, slashes its bond, and the ripple flags accounts. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 machines and 10,000 POA in bonds, while an honest agent pays one bond and bends like a willow through checks it passes, earning undiluted rewards.
